_comment: Composite indexes Firestore cannot infer. Deploy with:
Without these, the caregiver timeline and the missed-dose sweep fail at
runtime with FAILED_PRECONDITION rather than at build time.
Per-index comments are deliberately absent: the Firebase CLI validates
each index object against a fixed schema and rejects unknown keys, so a
'_comment' inside one of the entries below fails the whole deploy.
The caregiver timeline (patientId 'in' [...] ordered by occurredAt) is
served by the first events index. An 'in' filter is a set of equality
matches, so it uses the same ASCENDING index an equality filter would -
it does not need, and cannot use, an array-contains index.
